LanguageData.LP_PotionHealing.label: healing potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionHealing.description: A red potion made with troll blood as a base. All bleeding stops at once after drinking (like a simple bandaging), and natural healing speed ×3 for 6 hours. No effect on liches and necromantic constructs.
LanguageData.LP_PotionGreaterHealing.label: greater healing potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionGreaterHealing.description: A thick crimson potion. Same effect as a healing potion, and also regrows one missing finger or toe (only small parts like these). No effect on liches and necromantic constructs.
LanguageData.LP_PotionGiantStrength.label: potion of giant strength
LanguageData.LP_PotionGiantStrength.description: An orange potion that feels like swallowing a ball of fire. For 12 hours melee damage ×1.3, carrying capacity ×1.5, and the body looks a size bigger too.
LanguageData.LP_PotionFireResistance.label: fire resistance potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionFireResistance.description: A lukewarm amber potion. For 24 hours you won't catch fire, and fire damage taken -75%.
LanguageData.LP_PotionInvisibility.label: potion of invisibility
LanguageData.LP_PotionInvisibility.description: A nearly transparent potion; even the bottle is hard to see in the hand. After drinking, invisible for 2 hours; attacking reveals you at once and ends the effect. Cannot be crafted; only bought from Black Network caravans.
LanguageData.LP_PotionHeroism.label: potion of heroism
LanguageData.LP_PotionHeroism.description: A gleaming golden strong potion. For 8 hours no mental breaks, immune to fear effects (such as a lich's fear gaze), consciousness +10%.
LanguageData.LP_PotionMindShield.label: mind shield potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionMindShield.description: A pale purple potion distilled from a mind flayer brine jar. For 12 hours mind resistance +40% (adds to racial resistance, up to 95%).
LanguageData.LP_PotionTrollRegen.label: troll regenerant
LanguageData.LP_PotionTrollRegen.description: A dose of dark green draught concentrated from five vials of troll blood. For 3 days you gain weakened troll regeneration: wounds slowly heal while food is at least 50% (a quarter of a troll's rate); doesn't regrow lost limbs or revive; hunger rate ×1.5. When it wears off there's a 10% chance of troll blood addiction.
